Measure Definitions
data.1: Definitions

data.item: Return on Average Assets (ROAA) Calculated as net income for the period divided by average total assets over the same period.
data.1: Calculated as net income for the period divided by average total assets over the same period.

data.item: Return on Average Equity (ROAE) Calculated as net income for the period divided by average total shareholders' equity over the same period
data.1: Calculated as net income for the period divided by average total shareholders' equity over the same period

data.item: Average Interest-Earning Assets Computed quarterly and include cash and balances with banks, treasury instruments, and net loans to clients
data.1: Computed quarterly and include cash and balances with banks, treasury instruments, and net loans to clients

data.item: Net Interest Margin (NIM) Net interest income for the period divided by average interest-earning assets
data.1: Net interest income for the period divided by average interest-earning assets

data.item: Cost of Funds Interest expense for the period divided by average interest-bearing liabilities
data.1: Interest expense for the period divided by average interest-bearing liabilities

data.item: Total Operating Income Sum of net interest income and non-interest income for the period
data.1: Sum of net interest income and non-interest income for the period

data.item: Operating Costs Include total recurring operating expenses and bonuses (both paid and accrued)
data.1: Include total recurring operating expenses and bonuses (both paid and accrued)

data.item: Cost-to-Income Ratio Total recurring operating costs plus bonuses (paid and accrued), divided by total operating income
data.1: Total recurring operating costs plus bonuses (paid and accrued), divided by total operating income

data.item: Personnel Costs to Operating Costs Staff costs and bonuses (paid and accrued) divided by total recurring operating costs
data.1: Staff costs and bonuses (paid and accrued) divided by total recurring operating costs

data.item: Personnel Costs to Average Assets : Staff costs and bonuses (paid and accrued) divided by average total assets
data.1: : Staff costs and bonuses (paid and accrued) divided by average total assets

data.item: Client Deposits : Comprise deposits from corporates, financial institutions, and retail clients
data.1: : Comprise deposits from corporates, financial institutions, and retail clients

data.item: Liquid Assets Include cash, balances with the National Bank of Rwanda, balances with other banks, treasury instruments, and other fixed income securities
data.1: Include cash, balances with the National Bank of Rwanda, balances with other banks, treasury instruments, and other fixed income securities

data.item: Total Deposits The sum of interbank deposits and client deposits
data.1: The sum of interbank deposits and client deposits

data.item: Shareholders’ Equity Represents total shareholders’ equity at the reporting date
data.1: Represents total shareholders’ equity at the reporting date

data.item: Non-Performing Loans (NPLs) Loans classified as overdue by more than 90 days
data.1: Loans classified as overdue by more than 90 days

data.item: Large Exposures Loans or credit exposures that, in aggregate, exceed 10% of core capital
data.1: Loans or credit exposures that, in aggregate, exceed 10% of core capital

data.item: Cost of Risk Net provision for loan losses, plus provisions (or net recoveries) on other assets, divided by average gross loans to clients
data.1: Net provision for loan losses, plus provisions (or net recoveries) on other assets, divided by average gross loans to clients

data.item: Total Capital Adequacy Ratio (CAR) Total qualifying capital at period end divided by total risk-weighted assets, in line with National Bank of Rwanda regulations
data.1: Total qualifying capital at period end divided by total risk-weighted assets, in line with National Bank of Rwanda regulations

data.1: Year-on-year comparison based on values denominated in Rwandan Francs (RWF)
